👁️ Eye Check-up Camp – Chandivali
📅 Date: 1st November 2026

Rotary Club of Mulund Hill View successfully organised an Eye Check-up Camp at Chandivali.

Project Highlights:

* 👥 122 patients examined.
* 👁️ 11 cataract cases identified.
* 👓 70 pairs of spectacles distributed.

A small initiative, making a big difference through better vision and brighter smiles!

Rotary Club of Mulund Hill View
Service Above Self ❤️
